title: Boundary walls on up to two lot boundaries, R30-R40 narrow lots with rear right-of-way access
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, R30 - R40 where frontage is 8.5m or less and access is taken from a rear right of way: number of boundaries Two.

replaces.note: no narrow-lot row in Part C (C4P1-094)

verified.note: Page confirms 'Two' for the narrow rear-access row and 'All' for all other R30-R40 lots.

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#count-r30-r40-narrow. Table 3.4c (p34) values unchanged from Chapter 3; the clause text now cites C3.8.1 for overshadowing. Narrow lots (frontage 8.5 m or less, access from a rear right-of-way) are limited to two boundaries while other R30-R40 lots may build on all boundaries.
